prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1121; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane as they were merging. Both drivers reported as ambulatory at scene. Police report requested. Initial photos of both vehicles received and saved to file.

Entry 2: Claimant reports headache, dizziness, and light sensitivity following the collision and has been evaluated at an urgent care facility, where a concussion was diagnosed. Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be directed to the attorney of record. Letter of representation received and noted.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding the concussion diagnosis. Requested medical records and a current treatment plan. Attorney indicates client is still experiencing symptoms and has been referred to a neurologist. Authorization forms sent to counsel for signature. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect injury severity.

Entry 4: Liability analysis in progress. Police report indicates the other driver was cited for failure to maintain lane. Insured's dashcam footage reviewed and appears consistent with the other vehicle changing lanes into the insured's path. Subrogation considered against the other carrier. Awaiting the other carrier's position on fault.

Entry 5: Received neurologist's preliminary report through claimant's counsel, confirming post-concussion symptoms and recommending follow-up imaging and a period of restricted activity. Demand package expected from counsel. File flagged for supervisor review due to bodily injury exposure and attorney involvement. Next follow-up set for review of demand package.
